svg.aria-label: What I've built. Taad: Records your meetings and your day, then writes the notes, the to-dos and the calendar events. Built in 15 days. Crypto exchange: Trading, from the screens to the systems behind them. Mobile apps: The exchange's app, Taad on the phone, a news app for iOS. Crypto wallet: Self-custody wallets and crypto payments. Trading systems: Live prices and broker audits for traders. Verification platform: Liveness, face and document checks for any business. AI support desk: AI agents, live chat and tickets: a light CRM for websites. AI avatars: A human-like AI that runs interviews and sales calls. Study app: Lessons and practice for students. Online academy: Courses with an AI teacher beside every lesson. News sites: Game news in a dozen languages, published on its own. Gaming platform: Tournaments, player stats and game servers. Publishing: Brochures shared by link or QR code. Crawlers: Data from sites that never offered an API. Agents and bots: Bots that browse, post and reply on their own. Rebuilds: Apps rebuilt from the outside, just by studying them. Business websites: Showcase sites and catalogs for companies. Interactive stories: Small experiences with music, gifts and surprises. Animated icons: An icon set where every icon has its own motion. VoidBunny: Your coding agents, on your phone. Vibe Base: A database dashboard you host yourself. Hosting: Servers hardened from a bare box, with safe deploys. Your idea: Bring it. I'll map the system, then we build it.
